input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Section 10 is symmetrical and applies a "not unreasonably withheld" consent standard, but it contains no carve-out permitting Clear Capital to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. The fallback position requires at least a right to assign to successors (with notice), so consent-gated M&A/reorganization assignment fails the fallback on a material term. There is no competitor restriction on RadialSpark's assignment either. Termination (Section 6, p0031–p0033) contains no change-of-control trigger and the document has no change-of-control language anywhere, so there is no vendor exit or re-pricing right on our change of control — that aspect is fine. Minimal redline inserts the affiliate/successor carve-out for Company and bars assignment by Contractor to a Company competitor, reaching the preferred position without disturbing the mutual consent standard or the subcontracting restriction.

proposal.summary: Add Company affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and bar assignment by Contractor to a Company competitor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a carve-out so we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and so RadialSpark cannot assign to one of our competitors; our playbook does not permit corporate reorganizations or M&A to be gated on vendor consent. If helpful, we can instead make the successor right mutual on written notice.

ops.oldText: which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided, however, that Company may assign this Agreement, without Contractor's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business, and Contractor shall not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Company.
